# JoyHit

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Joystick](BlitzBasic-Joystick)

</div>


```blitzbasic
JoyHit:Int32 button:Int32, port:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `button` | In | Int32 | required | The button number, 1 to 32. |
| `port` | In | Int32 | `0` | The joystick to ask, counted from 0. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** How many times the button was pressed since the last call.

## Description

Counts presses of a joystick button since the last time JoyHit asked about that button.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local presses = 0
While Not KeyHit(1)
	presses = presses + JoyHit(1)
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Button 1 was pressed " + presses + " times"
	Flip
Wend
```
